models_evaluated: MEREDITH (Google Gemini Pro with retrieval-augmented generation and chain of thought)

links.outcome: Semantic similarity to tumor board recommendations, draft (PubMed only) versus enhanced system with curated evidence sources
links.effect: Semantic similarity rose from 0.71 to 0.76 (P = .01); concordance with expert recommendations was 94.7% for the enhanced system; median 4 options vs 2 for the MTB.
links.quote: This broader approach was achieved by incorporating a curated medical data set that contextualized molecular targetability.

links.outcome: Effect of iterative molecular tumor board expert feedback on LLM treatment suggestion relevance and similarity
links.effect: Iterative expert feedback improved suggestion relevance; semantic similarity rose from 0.71 to 0.76 (P = .01), with 94.7% concordance for the enhanced system.
links.quote: Expert feedback and domain-specific data augment LLM performance.

screen.reason: Evaluated the impact of adding domain-specific retrieval-augmented generation (clinical studies, trial databases, drug approval status, guidelines) to an initial LLM draft system on simulated oncology cases.

primary.practice: retrieval grounding added to an existing tool
